lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Mr. Gourmand,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: do you have a minute?
Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Oh no,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: nothing like that.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It's just that

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: since I'm now working with you in an official capacity,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I wanted to stop by and say hi.
I see.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: So anyway, could I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: How do you usually eat your meals?
I and the rest of the Counters Squad usually eat whatever's at hand.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: could I possibly take care of your meals going forward?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Of course, I could also include the other Counters members,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and heck, even the entire Outpost!
Okay, but I want the crème de la crème.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: By saying that,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: what do you mean?
I want everything to be a full-course meal.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: That shouldn't be a problem when you're in the Ark,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: but when you're on the surface...
I'm kidding.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: If I really set my mind to it, I could...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: You weren't being serious?
Of course not. But it sounds like it could actually be possible?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Even if it ended up not being possible,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I'll always try my best.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Just for you, Mr. Gourmand!
Hehe, well you don't have to go that far for me.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Still,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I really will do my best.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Nothing can put some pep in your step like good food.
Mmm...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Is something wrong?
No, I'm just really looking forward to trying your food.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe, I appreciate you saying that.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I'll come over and pay you a visit soon.
Sounds good. I'll make sure not to eat much beforehand.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: You really don't have to do that on my account.
